pages.title: Priorities - Kristen McDonald Rivet for Michigan
pages.text:
## My Priorities
Now more than ever, mid-Michigan families need elected leaders we trust to fight for us. I am a lifelong Michigander, raised in a house that my dad built himself. My husband and I raised six kids right here in mid-Michigan. And I have the honor of serving our communities in the State Senate. I spend my time in community, listening, and I know deeply the challenges and possibilities facing hard-working families across mid-Michigan.
I also have a record of working with leaders in both parties to deliver solutions for everyday problems impacting our community. I have taken on special interests and put more money in your pockets, protected our hard-earned freedoms, and supported law enforcement.
Now, I am running for Congress with the support of Congressman Kildee, to continue both of our work and deliver for you. Below are several of the priorities I plan to fight for, if you give me the chance to represent you in DC.
I hope to earn your vote by November 5. If you have questions, reach out to me and my team at [email protected] .

pages.title: Michigan Fraternal Order of Police endorses Democrat in key congressional race - Kristen McDonald Rivet for Michigan
pages.text:
October 8, 2024
## Michigan Fraternal Order of Police endorses Democrat in key congressional race
With less than a month until Election Day, state Sen. Kristen McDonald Rivet is showcasing her record on public safety as she secures an endorsement from one of the state’s oldest law enforcement unions.
The Michigan Fraternal Order of Police (FOP) announced on Tuesday it would endorse McDonald Rivet in Michigan’s 8th Congressional District — one of the most competitive in the county — pointing to her work to support law enforcement in previous offices.
“As a dedicated leader with a proven track record of advocacy and community engagement, Kristen embodies the qualities we need in our representatives,” Michigan Fraternal Order of Police President Michael Sauger said in a statement.
McDonald Rivet is set to face Paul Junge, a Trump-endorsed former prosecutor and U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services appointee, on election day, as both candidates seek to fill the seat left open by retiring U.S. Rep. Dan Kildee (D-Flint).
With more than 10,000 members, the Michigan Fraternal Order of Police was founded in 1939 as the state lodge of the national Fraternal Order of Police, which announced its endorsement of former President Donald Trump in September.
Alongside the Michigan Fraternal Order of Police, McDonald Rivet’s campaign also secured endorsements from the Michigan Corrections Organization, the Michigan Professional Fire Fighters Union, Genesee County Sheriff Chris Swanson and Genesee County Prosecutor David Leyton, appearing with Swanson and Leyton in an ad launched Tuesday where they noted her support for increased law enforcement funding in the Legislature.
“Keeping our communities safe has been and always will be a top priority for me, and I am honored to have the FOP in my corner,” McDonald Rivet said in a statement. “I will always stand by our police officers and fight to get them the resources, tools, and training they need to keep us safe.”

pages.title: Lowering Costs & Creating Opportunity - Kristen McDonald Rivet for Michigan
pages.text:
## Lowering Costs & Creating Opportunity
Growing up in a working-class, Michigan household, I learned that if you work hard, you should be able to support your family. But with costs rising faster than wages – especially here in Mid-Michigan – that reality is increasingly out of reach for too many. I will work tirelessly to lower costs and create opportunity, so that every Michigander has a pathway to work hard and afford to put food on the table, raise their family, and retire with dignity.
In the State Senate, I led the charge to pass the largest tax cut for working families, and helped repeal Michigan’s burdensome pension and retirement tax. I continue to take on special interests, introducing legislation to lower everyday costs like housing and prescription drugs, and to address the growing child care crisis in Michigan.
In Congress, my top priority will continue to be lowering the costs hurting mid-Michigan families . I will take on the corporate price gouging that drives up the price of groceries and gas. I will protect social security against extremists looking to cut or privatize it. I will take on the big drug companies to cap the price of insulin at $35 a month for everyone and allow Medicare to negotiate lower prices on more prescription drugs. I will work to lower the crushing cost to buy or rent a home. And I will expand the Child Tax Credit and cut taxes for working families while making big corporations and the uber wealthy pay their fair share.

pages.title: Creating Good Jobs in Mid-Michigan - Kristen McDonald Rivet for Michigan
pages.text:
## Creating Good Jobs in Mid-Michigan
I grew up in a working class household, where my dad worked from sun up to sun down to support our family. He and my mom taught my sisters and me the pride that comes from hard work. That’s why I firmly believe that hard work should allow you to support your family – whether you go to college or not. Here in mid-Michigan – the place where General Motors and the UAW put Americans on wheels – we need a champion to bring more good-paying jobs into our community and allow working families to succeed.
In the State Senate, I have fought to bring thousands of good-paying jobs to mid-Michigan, including manufacturing jobs with employers like Corning, Inc., SK Siltron, and Hemlock Semiconductor. I have been a steadfast ally of Michigan’s labor unions, including ending so-called “Right to Work” and restoring prevailing wage in Michigan.
In Congress, I will continue to fight to bring good-paying jobs and opportunity to mid-Michigan . I will work to make sure that we make things here in Michigan and bring supply chains home. I will fight back against trade deals that sell out American workers and make sure we stand up to adversaries, like China. And I will expand job training and apprenticeships, so that mid-Michiganders are trained for high-wage jobs that come to our region.

pages.title: Protecting Abortion Rights - Kristen McDonald Rivet for Michigan
pages.text:
## Protecting Abortion Rights
Reproductive healthcare decisions should be made between a woman and her doctor, not the government. I am proud to be endorsed by EMILY’s List and Planned Parenthood, who trust that I will always stand up for reproductive rights.
In the wake of the Supreme Court’s reversal of Roe v. Wade and efforts to ban IVF around the country, I stood up for Michigan women and helped repeal the state’s 1931 law that banned abortion without exceptions for rape or incest. Then I helped pass a law protecting the right to use IVF in Michigan.
Still, as far-right extremists push an all-out, federal abortion ban that would override the will of Michigan voters, the right to abortion is not safe. In Congress, I will stand up to anybody seeking to restrict reproductive freedom, and will not stop fighting until we pass federal legislation restoring Roe v. Wade as the law of our nation once again.

pages.title: Making Healthcare Accessible & Affordable - Kristen McDonald Rivet for Michigan
pages.text:
## Making Healthcare Accessible & Affordable
I know from my own family’s experience what it means to be prescribed drugs that you cannot afford. This is personal for me and so many I speak with across our region. Quality and affordable healthcare in America needs to be a right for everybody, regardless of pre-existing conditions.
In Congress, I will fight to ensure that every American has access to quality health insurance, care, and prescription drugs they can afford . I will expand the Affordable Care Act, allowing more Americans to buy into Medicare and increasing access and affordability. I will take on the big drug companies to cap the price of insulin at $35 a month for everyone and allow Medicare to negotiate lower prices on more prescriptions. And here on the ground, I will work closely with our hospital systems to ensure they get the federal resources they need to provide quality, timely care for all of our residents.

pages.title: Fighting for Seniors & Protecting Social Security - Kristen McDonald Rivet for Michigan
pages.text:
## Fighting for Seniors & Protecting Social Security
I was raised in a working class, Michigan household. I believe that if you work hard, you should be able to retire with dignity. Unfortunately, the rising cost of living is making that increasingly difficult, and we see too many seniors forced out of retirement and picking up shifts to make ends meet. It is despicable to see extremists try to cut taxes for the wealthy at the expense of working peoples’ hard-earned benefits. I will always fight for our seniors’ financial security, which is why I am proud to be endorsed by the National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare.
In the State Senate, I have stood by and delivered for Michigan seniors. I helped to repeal the Retirement Tax and protect workers’ pensions.
In Congress, I will continue to stand with Michigan seniors and protect your hard-earned benefits . I will fight anybody looking to cut benefits or raise the retirement age, and instead work to create a tax code that ensures the top 1% pay their fair share and that working families will have the money they need to retire. I will defend workers’ pensions, lower prescription drug costs, and protect Medicare.

pages.title: Keeping Mid-Michigan Families Safe - Kristen McDonald Rivet for Michigan
pages.text:
## Keeping Mid-Michigan Families Safe
Every family deserves to be and feel safe. I am proud to be endorsed by Genesee County Sheriff Chris Swanson and Prosecutor David Leyton, who know I stand with law enforcement to keep communities safe.
In the State Senate, I helped increase funding to put more law enforcement officers on our streets and for training and retention of our law enforcement officers. I championed common-sense gun violence prevention, including passing legislation to require safe gun storage around minors, implement universal background checks, and allow courts to temporarily remove guns from people who are judged to be an extreme risk to themselves or others.
In Congress, I will continue to stand with law enforcement and fight to make sure our police departments have the resources they need to keep Mid-Michigan communities safe . I will help secure federal grants to put more cops on the beat, increase training opportunities, and secure the right tools to help law enforcement officials do their jobs. I will stand up for common-sense reforms that address gun violence while protecting our second amendment rights, and make sure we make proper investments in housing, education, mental health services, and addiction counseling to address the root causes of crime.

pages.title: Priorities - Kristen McDonald Rivet for Michigan
pages.text:
## My Priorities
Now more than ever, it feels like things are stacked against us. Groceries and prescriptions are unaffordable, gas is through the roof, and home ownership feels out of reach for the majority of Michiganders. All the while, most politicians seem more focused on social media followers and lining their own pockets than actually helping you.
I have lived in Michigan my entire life, raised my kids here, and I know we all deserve so much better. It is time for big ideas and real solutions, not platitudes and empty promises. That’s why in Congress, I’m taking on the broken system and working on solutions to make sure you keep more of your hard-earned money. Below are just some of the ways I have and will continue to fight.
I hope to earn your vote on or by November 3rd. If you have questions, reach out to me and my team at [email protected] .
## Working With Both Parties to Get Stuff Done

pages.title: Fixing A Broken System - Kristen McDonald Rivet for Michigan
pages.text:
## Fixing A Broken System
Washington is broken – while families are falling further and further behind, politicians and special interests are cashing in. In order to make actual progress, we need to fix the systems that are failing us. First of all, no one should be profiting from their position in elected office. Kristen worked with both parties to introduce legislation to make it illegal for members of Congress to trade stock or participate in prediction markets where they have insider information.
Next, Kristen is fighting to get big, unlimited money out of politics, leading efforts to reverse Citizens United . Kristen also knows that voters should pick their leaders, not the other way around, so she supports bills to expand Michigan’s anti-gerrymandering practices to the rest of the country. Kristen is not scared to take on special interests, and when members of either party put themselves over our communities, Kristen fights back.
## Lowering Costs

pages.title: Lowering Costs - Kristen McDonald Rivet for Michigan
pages.text:
## Lowering Costs
As a mother of six kids, Kristen knows firsthand how rising prices are affecting Michigan families. That’s why she is laser-focused on providing relief and lowering costs. In the State Senate, she passed the largest tax cut for working families in Michigan’s history and ended Michigan’s burdensome retirement tax.
In Congress, Kristen led the effort to pass through the House a tax cut for families buying healthcare. She is working to force prescription drug companies to negotiate prices with Medicaid, put an end to reckless tariffs, and stop Wall Street from buying up our housing. She is also a leader of a bipartisan group of members focused on cutting red tape that is causing sky-high costs of utilities and housing.
## Fixing A Broken System

pages.title: Healthcare We Can Afford - Kristen McDonald Rivet for Michigan
pages.text:
## Healthcare We Can Afford
The current state of healthcare in America is crushing working families. MAGA’s $1 trillion cut to Medicaid made things much worse, causing premiums to rise 17% for working families in Michigan. For Mid-Michigan to thrive, healthcare must be affordable and accessible for everybody.
Kristen led the effort to pass through the House a tax cut for families buying healthcare, and she is fighting to let every American have the choice to buy into Medicare. She wrote bipartisan legislation to make pricing more transparent, and she is standing up to pharmaceutical companies by working to force them to negotiate prices with Medicaid.
## Fixing A Broken System

pages.title: Supporting Public Safety - Kristen McDonald Rivet for Michigan
pages.text:
## Supporting Public Safety
Kristen knows that for mid-Michigan families to thrive, they need to feel and be safe. For far too long, local police and sheriffs have been underfunded, and Kristen is working to fix that. As a Bay City Commissioner, she increased funding to hire additional officers, and in the state Senate, she brought back to local departments millions to fund more officers, tools, and training.
In Congress, Kristen has secured millions in federal investments into our local departments, and she co-sponsors the bipartisan bill to fully fund local law enforcement.
## Fixing A Broken System

pages.title: Working With Both Parties to Get Stuff Done - Kristen McDonald Rivet for Michigan
pages.text:
## Working With Both Parties to Get Stuff Done
Kristen doesn’t play political games and works with anyone, regardless of party, to solve the problems facing Mid-Michigan. In her first year, she introduced 19 bills, all of which have a Republican partner, and two of her bills were signed into law by President Trump.
When her own party pushed an EV mandate that would kill Michigan auto jobs, she fought back and helped stop it. She consistently works with both parties to lower costs, strengthen our border, and support local law enforcement, and that’s why she is rated the most bipartisan member of Congress from Michigan.
## Fixing A Broken System
